meaning: You do not have to do.

examples.japanese: 明日は来なくてもいい。
examples.reading: あしたはこなくてもいい。
examples.gloss: You do not have to come tomorrow.

examples.japanese: 全部食べなくてもいい。
examples.reading: ぜんぶたべなくてもいい。
examples.gloss: You do not have to eat it all.
There is no need to hurry.

usage: Says an action is not needed. It does not say you must not do it.
Polite: なくてもいいです. Also seen as なくてもかまわない.

compare.difference: なければならない says you must. なくてもいい says you do not need to.
てもいい gives permission to do. なくてもいい gives permission not to.
